recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-12430 unless a future work group decision changes the treatment of QuestionnaireResponse instances whose questionnaire canonical cannot be resolved.
issue_request: FHIR-12430 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and requested a usage note on QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire saying that, when a QuestionnaireResponse references a Questionnaire, the response structure must be consistent with the Questionnaire, including group organization and nested questions.
initial_application: The request was applied historically by commit 6048380f2c7ce7028763d9790403cc48c6839438, which added the consistency note to source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-notes.xml. Later source rework commits such as 33b409a4b6 and c69d71aa21 carried the same sentence into source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml for QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-37550 made QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire 1..1 and added caveats for non-resolving or legacy Questionnaire references, which explains the current qualifier that the consistency rule applies when the referenced Questionnaire can be resolved. Zulip discussions in 2018 and 2019 challenged the rule and recorded rationale for retaining matching structure, especially for repeated groups; no Confluence reference for FHIR-12430 was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinition element comment and the QuestionnaireResponse narrative page both convey the FHIR-12430 consistency rule, and reverting to the original unqualified sentence would conflict with later FHIR-37550 guidance.
